title: Terp Standard conformance scorecard
description: The machine-readable certification summary a checker emits after running the corpus: which spec version it certified against, which rules it claims, and the per-rule verdict over the corpus cases. This turns 'certified against spec X.Y.Z' into a verifiable artifact instead of a claim — a consumer can re-run the corpus and reproduce the scorecard. Residual claims must be a subset of corpus/RESIDUALS.json for the rule; claiming a residual the spec does not record is a conformance failure.

spec_version.description: The spec semver (VERSION) the checker certified against.

checker.description: The checker's identity: tool name and its own version.

rules.description: One entry per catalog rule the checker claims conformance for. A rule not listed is not claimed.

rule.description: The catalog rule id the verdict is for.

pass.description: True when every violation-* case produced a finding for this rule and every compliant-* case produced none.

residuals_claimed.description: The corpus/RESIDUALS.json entries (verbatim strings) for this rule the checker relies on; must be a subset of the spec's recorded residuals.
